answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 18 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in reef, checked in grove, and velvet makes public each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases since the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 1842 identities would post 3149 proofs and burn roughly 45 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
